recommendation_title: Prioritize Billing/Support: Fix Free-Tier Playback Controls
recommendation: The top-ranked issue by priority score is ISS-BILLING-PREMIUM_ONLY_CONTROLS, with 12 complaints [C001], a severity sum of 36 [C002], and mean severity 3.0 [C003], giving it the highest priority score of 36 [C004] in the entire pack. This single issue also drives the billing_support area to the top area-level severity sum of 38 among all areas. Reviews describe free users losing basic player controls after an update, e.g. `21915fcd-9a35-48ba-b277-6296c4154603` ('made everthing premium and so usless') and `7084ced1-0428-4093-9328-442f74719b4f` ('removed basic features of music player'), indicating a clear, well-defined product gap to address next quarter.

alternatives.title: Access
alternatives.why_not_first: Access has the highest mean severity (4.000000, area table) and all 4 of its complaints are sev4plus, but total complaint volume is small (ISS-ACCESS-APP_WONT_OPEN: 2 complaints [C013], priority score 8 [C016]; ISS-ACCESS-LOGIN: 2 complaints [C017], priority score 8 [C020]), so it ranks below billing on overall priority score.

alternatives.title: Usability
alternatives.why_not_first: Usability's top issue, ISS-USABILITY-ADS, has 8 complaints [C009] and priority score 19 [C012], lower than ISS-BILLING-PREMIUM_ONLY_CONTROLS's score of 36 [C004], even though usability has the second-highest area severity sum (26, area table).

alternatives.title: Playback
alternatives.why_not_first: Playback has only 6 complaints and a severity sum of 18 at the area level, with no single playback issue appearing in the top_issues list, making it the weakest-evidenced candidate this quarter.
